title: Software Tester
description:
Develop and implement comprehensive test plans to ensure high-quality software delivery. Design and execute automated tests using Java/Python to improve testing efficiency. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize testing requirements. Analyze test results and report defects to the development team. Participate in agile methodologies such as Scrum to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products. Continuously monitor and enhance testing processes to improve overall quality.
